_comment: One source for the security policy. app.py sends these as headers, tests/conftest.py sends the Content-Security-Policy as a header too, and index.html carries the same policy in a meta tag (GitHub Pages cannot send headers). A meta policy cannot express frame-ancestors, so the meta variant is derived by dropping that one directive. tests/test_security_policy.py asserts all three agree.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://learnwithclay.ai https://jetson.tail155e26.ts.net; frame-ancestors 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
